page_description: Voting from Abroad – Simple, Digital, Secure
voting_intro_paragraph_1: This form allows citizens of the Republic of Serbia living abroad to submit a request to vote outside the country. The process includes checking registration in the electoral roll, entering personal information, and selecting the diplomatic-consular mission (embassy or consulate) where they wish to vote.
voting_intro_paragraph_2: Please fill out all information carefully to ensure your request is valid. After successful completion, the system will automatically generate a document that you can download and submit to the appropriate diplomatic mission.
voting_intro_note: Note: To open a polling station abroad, at least 100 registered voters must apply per location.
check_list_info: Check if you are registered in the unified voter list by clicking the button below, then return to this page:
generate_request_for_list: Generate a request to register in the voter list?
full_name_description: Enter your full name as it appears in your document
parent_name_description: Enter the name of one of your parents
parent_name_error: Please enter the name of one of your parents.
jmbg_description: Enter your Unique Master Citizen Number
jmbg_error_length: JMBG must be exactly 13 digits long.
address_description: Enter the address from your official document
address_error: Please enter your residence address in Serbia.
address_abroad_description: Enter the address where you currently reside abroad
country_description: Choose the country from which you will vote
embassy_description: Choose the consular office where you want to submit your request
city_description: Enter the city you wish to vote from, or leave it blank if it matches the selected consular
signature_description: Sign here using your finger or mouse
next_steps_step_1: Take a photo of both sides of your ID card or the first page of your passport.
next_steps_step_2:
Download the completed application form for voting abroad.
 If you selected the option to generate the request for voter list registration, it will also be downloaded.
next_steps_step_3: Send an email to the embassy and attach the downloaded forms along with the photo of the document.
